content.title: ‘Fortnite’ Down — Here’s When Servers Go Live For Chapter 7, Season 2 ‘Showdown’
content.text: FortniteCredit: EpicEpic Games have taken Fortnite servers offline to push the big Chapter 7, Season 2 ‘Showdown’ update. The new season kicks off Thursday, March 19th with a brand new Battle Pass, and some map changes, including the Frigid Fortress, which replaces Clawsy Lodge and The Seven HQ, which replaces Classified Canyon.The new season is built around rivalries, primarily a clash between The Foundation and the Ice King, who has frozen The Foundation as part of his private collection. The Dark Voyager teams up with the Ice King this season as part of The Dark Voyager Saga.A new Rivalry system lets players mark enemies as rivals during matches for special buffs and in-match benefits. As with some previous seasons, players can also choose a faction, joining either The Foundation or the Ice King to earn rewards.PROMOTEDA new Skyzip device is also coming to the game, as well as the Rift Rifle. Meanwhile, Surfing is being vaulted, XP is being readjusted and the Save the World mode is going free-to-play. Meanwhile, V-Bucks are getting a price hike, making shopping in the in-game store a bit pricier, though you can save 20% by purchasing directly through the Epic Games Store. The Battle Pass itself will now cost 800 V-Bucks instead of 1,000 (with 800 V-Bucks earnable through play) but an $8.99 pack, which previously netted you 1,000 V-Bucks, will now net you 800.When Will ‘Fortnite’ Servers Come Back Online?There’s no exact time set for Fortnite to come back online, but estimates are sometime between 4 AM and 7 AM PT which translates to 7 AM - 10 AM ET. You can see what that is in your time-zone right here.MORE FOR YOUThis is because updates of this size are not entirely predictable and there are some unknown factors as Epic rolls this one out. Still, it should be faster than a big Chapter update, some of which have seen the game go down for more than a day.Here’s the Season 2 trailer: Email Address The Battle Pass, meanwhile, sees the return of the Ice King and The Rock – aka The Foundation, along with some other pretty fun skins:FortniteCredit: EpicI remember getting the original Ice King skin years ago, back in Chapter 1, Season 7. This new version definitely looks cool, but the Ice Gremlin sidekick is probably my favorite part of this Battle Pass. Octopus Boy is pretty neat also.Even more exciting? The Looney Tunes are coming to Fortnite, so now you can hunt a rascally rabbit with an Elmer Fudd skin – a classic rivalry if ever there was one.Fortnite Chapter 7, Season 2 will go live once servers are back online. Just be sure to update the game on your end as well.
